title: common_preferred_spread summary.json data (v1)
description: Common/preferred spread. 'pairs' is the FULL list in config.json order. The hub derives the TOP card (spread desc, one row per commonCode = the widest spread) and per-code lookups (first pair whose commonCode or preferredCode matches).

spreadPct1y.description: Optional. Share of samples at or below the current spread in the trailing 365 days ending at spreadPctEnd (dashboard card rule: integer, at least 30 samples, else null).

spreadPctEnd.description: Optional. Last date of the daily distribution (data/summary.json spreadPercentiles.date).

attractiveness.description: Optional. data/summary.json attractiveness.total, 0-100 (spread, spread position, liquidity, dividend, common-stock health).

commonAvgTradedValue20.description: Optional. Common stock 20-session average traded value, KRW.

preferredAvgTradedValue20.description: Optional. Preferred stock 20-session average traded value, KRW.
